notes.title: Visual Novel Fest
notes.content:
Mirrorrandum is taking part in Steam Visual Novel Fest, celebrating the beauty of storytelling through immersive narratives and stunning visuals. Whether you’re drawn to deep philosophical themes, emotional journeys, or captivating worlds, Mirrorrandum promises to be a unique experience.

Get ready to explore its mysterious, dreamlike story and lose yourself in a world where reality and illusion intertwine. Don’t miss the chance to discover Mirrorrandum during the festival!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477359/82957cfd396558868a5c50b7bcaa80dbde9aca99.png[/img]

notes.title: Mirrorandum has been released!
notes.content:
A little visual novel Mirrorandum has been released! It’s a strange, ephemeral, reflective project that appeared by chance.

You play as an immobilized character in a mysterious world filled with mirrors, in which you see different reflections. Who are these figures and why do they appear before you? And who are you?

In the game, each character has three possible endings, which you can reach by making your own choices (of course, accompanied by achievements).

I’d be happy if you played this visual novel and write a review - curious to see how another human soul perceives it.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477359/d8f83d5637596eae1c848e73904782ad75d27b39.png[/img]
